_comment: Declared required status-check contexts per protected branch. This file is the local, zero-outbound source of truth for scripts/check_required_check_coverage.py, which asserts that every context listed here is produced by a workflow that triggers UNCONDITIONALLY on a pull request into that branch. Refresh it by hand from `python scripts/check_required_check_coverage.py --sync`, which prints the live state via the user's own `gh` CLI and never writes. v3.17.6 sub-task 2.2 collapsed ci.yml's nine contexts into the single `ci-required` aggregate: GitHub evaluates a job-level `if:` before matrix expansion, so a skipped matrix job publishes only its bare job name and a per-leg context such as `installer-smoke (ubuntu-latest)` can sit Pending forever. Never add a `job (leg)` context here; tests/validators/test_ci_required_gate.py enforces that.
